reviews.title: Making Your Mess Your Message
reviews.body: Kudos to the host for having the wisdom and gift to highlight a subject that most people tend to ignore or hide. This episode featured a person who experienced some dark times, but eventually allowed the Lord to lead him to the Light.
reviews.author: Ruth

reviews.title: Balm to my Soul
reviews.body: While I am a little biased, because you interviewed my dad for one of your episodes. But I listened to most of the other episodes and found them all to be so inspirational and encouraging. Given how this is such a dark time in our history, it is uplifting to hear stories of hope and resilience from every day folks. These unsung hero are the real celebrities we should be looking up to as role models.
reviews.author: Judi Henderson

reviews.title: Pride
reviews.body: This podcast is not only entertaining but it makes you feel such pride. I’m so happy for Curtis and all the guests!
reviews.author: MarticiaC

reviews.title: Deeply Insightful & inspirational!
reviews.body: I appreciate how you let the conversations flow with integrity, honesty & Compassion. The questions you ask are relevant & insightful . Keep doing great work!!!
reviews.author: V.R.

reviews.title: Thank you for an excellent presentation!
reviews.body: Dear Curtis, I just finished listening to the Uncovered Legacy about Franklin Henderson! It is superb! I was prompted to listen to it by my dear friend Judi Henderson, the daughter of Doris and Franklin Henderson, whom I met while I was a resident of Oakland. I now reside in Los Angeles. Judi and I have been friends for at least 19 years. And I've had the honor of meeting Mr. and Mrs. Henderson on a couple of occasions while they visited Judi in Oakland a few years ago. All that being said, I am fascinated and enthralled by your journalistic skills and talents. Your narration was truly inspiring and heartwarming. Thank you so much, and I look forward to listening to other podcasts here, as I have joined your mailing list. Best regards, Gaye
reviews.author: Gaye Walton-Price

reviews.title: A Podcast that Gives Voice, Power and Community
reviews.body: Uncovered Legacy Podcast is a truly powerful and meaningful show. As an avid podcast listener, I can honestly say this is one of the ones I look forward. The stories shared are real, honest, and deeply moving—and they give voice to experiences that so many of us carry but rarely get to hear reflected back. What makes Uncovered Legacy special is how it creates both power and connection. It doesn’t just tell stories—it builds community. Each episode leaves me feeling seen, encouraged, and reminded that our stories matter. If you’re looking for a podcast that uplifts, validates, and brings people together through shared experiences, Uncovered Legacy is absolutely worth listening to.
reviews.author: bommrag

reviews.title: Little League Perseverance
reviews.body: I throughly enjoyed the interview with John Rivers. The story captured the essence of perseverance and strong ties in the Black family and hopefully someone is encouraged and motivated to help our young people succeed.
reviews.author: Mary R. Burke, daughter-in-law of Walter T. Burke

reviews.title: Inspirational
reviews.body: We really enjoyed the interview and wanted to hear more.
reviews.author: Glenn and Mary

reviews.title: Refreshing and Inspiring
reviews.body: I LOVE what you’re doing here! The voice and stories are just what we need in times like today; reminders of hope and what we get to share as time goes on.
reviews.author: Candace Claiborn
